public.research_request: Sample SAMN09099384 (C. elegans mutation-accumulation line 1A), NCBI Taxonomy 6239, paired-end WGS reads registered. Reference GCF_000002985.6 with the genomic FASTA. Call variants to a VCF, then tell me whether the sample carries these sites (1-based, on GCF_000002985.6): V:2129317 C>T, X:765242 C>A, III:4821044 G>A and X:15696111 G>C.

prepared_answers.reason: The request says paired-end WGS: genomic DNA in a paired layout.

questions.ask: Does every accession, TaxId and rsID in the planning Tool calls appear in the request or an earlier recorded result?

questions.ask: Are the planning Reviews raised exactly the ones the request leaves open (no over-clarification)?

Is sample_identity asserted exactly as SAMN09099384?
